content_of_post_to_comment: One of the reasons Trump is so dangerous because he’s eroding the one advantage the US always has had and always will have over China. The US is an alliance superpower in a way China’s revanchinist foreign policy could never emulate. China would never be able to construct an alliance network as resilient and robust as the US.
comment: The alliance advantage depends not only on having partners, but on partners believing commitments will outlast electoral cycles. The harder question is how a superpower preserves trust when domestic politics becomes part of foreign policy.
